summary: Bushnell–Henniart attach to each endo-class Θ a Herbrand function Ψ_Θ, relating the ultrametric on endo-classes of simple characters to the decomposition function of the corresponding Weil representation under the local Langlands correspondence. They prove the Interpolation Theorem that characterizes Ψ_Θ through tame base change, and compute it in low-dimensional and degree-p cases. Complete (cc-442dc5): every labelled statement is an item, every missing item is routed exactly once, and seventeen findings are recorded. The auxiliary lemma of §5.3 at k = m (E5), the §7.4 level formula (E7) and the §8.4–8.5 claims (E12, E13) are false as printed; the main theorems are unaffected. Not formalised.

items.name: Semisimplicity of normal restriction
items.statement: For a field k, group G, normal subgroup N, and finite-dimensional irreducible k-representation V of G, Res_N V is semisimple. No finiteness of G and no Maschke characteristic condition is needed.

items.statement: Under the preceding hypotheses there is a minimal nonzero N-subrepresentation S, and every minimal N-subrepresentation is isomorphic to a G-conjugate of S.

items.statement: Under the same hypotheses there is e>0 such that dim_k Hom_N(S,Res_N V)=e for every minimal constituent S. Over C, Schur identifies this with the ordinary multiplicity.

items.name: Upper ramification and right-limit groups

items.name: Independence and correct realization scaling of jumps
items.statement: S_Θ is independent of θ, ψ_F, β and the realization. For another realization of the same parameter with periods e_a,e_a′, S[a′,β]=(e_a′/e_a)S[a,β].

items.name: Piecewise parameter-field profile
items.statement: For x≥0 outside S_Θ, use γ_x=β below the least jump, γ_x=0 above m_Θ, and otherwise an approximation at t−1 where t/e_a is the next jump above x. Put E_x=F[γ_x], d_Θ(x)=[E_x:F], e_Θ(x)=e(E_x/F), c_Θ(x)=c(γ_x).

api.name: endoProfile_initial
api.statement: Below min S_Θ the parameter is β.

api.name: endoProfile_final
api.statement: Above m_Θ, E_x=F, d=e=1 and c=0.

api.name: endoProfile_invariants
api.statement: Return d_Θ(x), e_Θ(x), c_Θ(x) with their realization comparisons.

uses.how: Compute both slopes and intercepts of Φ.
Determine the last nontrivial slope.

items.name: Profile invariants are intrinsic and locally constant
items.statement: The numbers d_Θ(x), e_Θ(x), c_Θ(x) depend only on Θ and x and are constant between successive members of {0,∞}∪S_Θ.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Structure function of an endo-class
items.statement: For Θ≠0 and 0<x<m_Θ outside S_Θ put Φ_Θ(x)=c_Θ(x)/d_Θ(x)²+x/d_Θ(x); put Φ_Θ(x)=x for x>m_Θ, and extend continuously. Define Φ_0(x)=x. Its inverse has domain [Φ_Θ(0),∞), not all nonnegative reals unless Φ_Θ(0)=0.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

api.name: structureFunction_piece
api.statement: On a profile interval Φ(x)=c/d²+x/d.

api.name: structureFunction_tail
api.statement: Φ(x)=x for x≥m_Θ.

api.name: structureFunction_inverse
api.statement: Strict increase and the identity tail give an order isomorphism [0,∞)≅[Φ(0),∞).

uses.how: Recover the pair conductor.
Define Ψ only after showing Σ(0)=Φ(0).

items.name: Continuous gluing of the structure function
items.statement: The left and right affine limits agree at every jump in S_Θ, so Φ has a unique continuous extension to x≥0.

items.name: Convexity and strict increase of Φ
items.statement: Φ_Θ is piecewise affine, convex and strictly increasing on [0,∞); its slope on a profile interval is 1/d_Θ(x).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Derivative breaks of Φ
items.statement: The derivative breaks of Φ are precisely S_Θ, except that m_Θ is not a break if E_x=F immediately below m_Θ.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Simple characters on one stratum have the same Φ
items.statement: If θ_i∈C(a,β) have endo-classes Θ_i, then Φ_{Θ_1}=Φ_{Θ_2}.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Dual simple character and dual endo-class
items.statement: For θ∈C(a,β), θ^−1∈C(a,−β); its class Θ∨ is independent of realization and satisfies (Θ∨)∨=Θ and Φ_{Θ∨}=Φ_Θ.

api.name: endoDual_realize
api.statement: The inverse character on H^1 realizes Θ∨ with parameter −β.

api.name: endoDual_involutive
api.statement: Dualizing twice returns Θ.

uses.how: Use the contragredient in the pair conductor.
Match Weil duality through LLC.

items.name: Agreement of Φ after intertwining truncations
items.statement: If θ_i∈C(a,β_i) intertwine after restriction to H^{t+1}(β_i,a), t≥0, then Φ_{Θ_1}(x)=Φ_{Θ_2}(x) for x≥t/e_a.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Tame lifts of endo-classes
items.statement: For finite tame K/F, the BH96 transfer/restriction construction assigns a finite nonempty set of K/F-lifts of Θ∈E(F), independent of realizations. Lifts compose in towers; for Galois K/F they form a Gal(K/F)-orbit.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

api.name: endoLift_nonempty
api.statement: Every Θ has at least one K/F-lift.

api.name: endoLift_tower
api.statement: L/K/F lifting equals composition of the two lifting operations.

api.name: endoLift_galoisOrbit
api.statement: For Galois K/F, the lifts are one Gal(K/F)-orbit.

uses.how: Express A by a minimum over lifts.
Reduce Ψ calculations to totally wild classes.

items.name: Totally wild endo-class
items.statement: An endo-class Θ is totally wild when e_Θ=deg Θ=p^r for some r≥0; equivalently its parameter field is totally wildly ramified. Under every finite tame K/F it has a unique lift, still totally wild of the same degree.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

api.name: totallyWild_iff
api.statement: e_Θ=deg Θ and that common value is a power of p.

api.name: totallyWild_uniqueTameLift
api.statement: Select the unique K/F-lift when Θ is totally wild.

api.name: totallyWild_tameLift_degree
api.statement: Tame lifting preserves its p-power degree.

uses.how: State interpolation with a single Θ_K.
Analyze degree-p classes.

items.name: Tame scaling of Φ for totally wild classes
items.statement: For totally wild Θ and finite tame K/F with e=e(K/F), S_{Θ_K}=eS_Θ, d_{Θ_K}(ex)=d_Θ(x), and Φ_{Θ_K}(x)=eΦ_Θ(x/e).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Intertwining distance on endo-classes
items.statement: Realize Θ_1,Θ_2 on a common hereditary order a and let l≥0 be the least integer at which their restrictions to H^{l+1} intertwine. Define A(Θ_1,Θ_2)=l/e_a, allowing the trivial U_a^1-character to represent 0.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

api.name: endoDistance_realization
api.statement: A=l/e_a on any common realization.

api.name: endoDistance_lt_iff_truncate
api.statement: For ε>0, A(Θ,Υ)<ε iff their ε-truncated endo-classes agree.

uses.how: Evaluate the conductor profile at A.
Compare metric balls with Δ.

items.name: Independence of the intertwining distance
items.statement: A is independent of all common realizations, additive characters and transfer choices.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Distance to zero and unequal-level formula
items.statement: A(Θ,0)=m_Θ. If m_Θ≠m_Υ then A(Θ,Υ)=max(m_Θ,m_Υ).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Separation and ultrametric inequality for A
items.statement: A(Θ,Υ)=0 iff Θ=Υ; A is symmetric and A(Θ,Ξ)≤max(A(Θ,Υ),A(Υ,Ξ)).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Tail agreement at the endo-distance
items.statement: Φ_Θ(x)=Φ_Υ(x) whenever x≥A(Θ,Υ).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Real-index truncation of endo-classes
items.statement: For ε>0 and a realization θ on period e_a put t=ceil(e_a ε)−1, so t/e_a<ε≤(t+1)/e_a. Restrict θ to H^{t+1}; its truncated endo-class tc_ε(Θ) is independent of realization, with the trivial high-depth case treated explicitly.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

api.name: endoTruncation_level
api.statement: The integer t satisfies t<e_a ε≤t+1.

api.name: endoTruncation_eq_iff
api.statement: tc_ε(Θ)=tc_ε(Υ) iff A(Θ,Υ)<ε.

api.name: endoTruncation_trans
api.statement: Further truncation to a larger real depth factors through the smaller-depth truncation.

uses.how: Parametrize a truncated class by a ramification orbit and an index.
Separate agreement at H^{k+1} from disagreement at H^k.

items.name: Strict balls are truncated endo-classes
items.statement: For ε>0, A(Θ,Υ)<ε iff tc_ε(Θ)=tc_ε(Υ).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Interior-depth perturbation of a simple character
items.statement: For [a,m,0,β] and θ∈C(a,β), and 1≤k<m, the corrected helper produces [a,m,0,β′] and θ′∈C(a,β′) with H^k unchanged, θ′=θ on H^{k+1}, and no intertwining on H^k. The printed inclusion of k=m is false in general.
items.locator: BH17 §5.3 helper Lemma p.939, corrected range
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Density of endo-distances
items.statement: For fixed Θ, {A(Θ,Υ):Υ∈E(F)} is dense in [0,∞).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Endo-class of a cuspidal representation
items.statement: Every irreducible smooth complex cuspidal representation π of GL_n(F) contains a simple character, unique up to GL_n(F)-conjugacy. Its endo-class Θ_π is therefore well defined; every endo-class occurs for some cuspidal representation.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

api.name: cuspidalEndoClass
api.statement: Return the class of any simple character contained in π.

api.name: cuspidalEndoClass_independent
api.statement: All simple characters occurring in π give the same class.

api.name: cuspidalEndoClass_surjective
api.statement: For every Θ there is a cuspidal π with Θ_π=Θ.

uses.how: Make conductors into functions on endo-classes.
State the first ramification theorem.

items.name: Rankin–Selberg local constants
items.statement: For complex cuspidal π_i of GL_{n_i}(F), ε(π_1×π_2,s,ψ) is a monomial in q^−s of degree n_1n_2 c(ψ)+Ar(π_1×π_2), with the additive-character convention fixed; Ar is independent of ψ.
items.note: Existing stage scope is an import, not a claim of an available Lean proof.

api.name: pairArtinExponent
api.statement: Extract the integer Ar after subtracting n_1n_2 c(ψ).

api.name: pairEpsilon_changeAdditive
api.statement: Changing ψ alters the known additive-character term, not Ar.

api.name: pairEpsilon_isomorphic
api.statement: Isomorphic representations have equal factors.

Use LLC compatibility of local constants.

items.name: Swan exponent on the GL side
items.statement: Let d(π_1,π_2) be the number of unramified χ with χπ_1≅π_2∨; set sw(π_1×π_2)=Ar(π_1×π_2)−n_1n_2+d(π_1,π_2). The count vanishes if n_1≠n_2.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

api.name: pairSwan_def
api.statement: sw=Ar−n_1n_2+d in the stated dual convention.

api.name: unramifiedTwistCount_rank_ne
api.statement: Unequal ranks imply d=0.

api.name: pairSwan_normalized
api.statement: Normalize by n_1n_2 only for the separate pairing ς.

Identify the inertia-invariant correction with the Galois Artin–Swan difference.

items.name: Explicit GL_n conductor formula
items.statement: For cuspidal π_i and Θ_i=Θ_{π_i}, sw(π_1∨×π_2)/(n_1n_2)=Φ_{Θ_1}(A(Θ_1,Θ_2))=Φ_{Θ_2}(A(Θ_1,Θ_2)).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Normalized Swan equals endo level
items.statement: For cuspidal π of GL_n(F), sw(π)/n=m_{Θ_π}.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Conductor characterization of Φ
items.statement: For fixed Θ and any cuspidal π with Θ_π=Θ, Φ_Θ is the unique continuous function on [0,∞) taking A(Θ,Θ_ρ) to sw(π∨×ρ)/(gr π·gr ρ) for every cuspidal ρ.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Ultrametric inequality for the endo-class conductor pairing
items.statement: The pairing ς(Θ,Υ)=Φ_Θ(A(Θ,Υ)) is symmetric and obeys ς(Θ,Ξ)≤max(ς(Θ,Υ),ς(Υ,Ξ)); it need not vanish on the diagonal.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Tame minimum formula for A
items.statement: For finite tame K/F of ramification index e and all lifts Θ_i,Υ_j, e A_F(Θ,Υ)=min_{i,j}A_K(Θ_i,Υ_j)=min_j A_K(Θ_1,Υ_j) for any fixed lift Θ_1.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Classical complex local Langlands in characteristic zero
items.statement: For F finite over Q_p, the classical LLC bijects cuspidal complex GL_n(F)-representations with n-dimensional irreducible complex Weil representations, respects duals and character twists, and preserves epsilon factors of pairs in the chosen normalization.
items.note: Existing stage scope is an import, not a claim of an available Lean proof.

items.name: Equal-characteristic complex LLC and pair factors
items.statement: For F≅F_q((t)), supply the same cuspidal/irreducible complex bijection with dimension, dual, character-twist and epsilon-of-pairs compatibility; make the coefficient transport from the ℓ-adic realization explicit.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Swan compatibility of LLC
items.statement: For cuspidal π,ρ over either allowed F, sw(π×ρ)=sw(Lπ⊗Lρ), hence their normalized conductors agree after dividing by ranks/dimensions.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: First ramification bijection
items.statement: The W_F-orbit LΘ=[Lπ;0]^+ depends only on Θ=Θ_π. This defines a canonical bijection E(F)≅W_F\Irr(P_F), compatible with field isomorphisms and tame lifting.
items.locator: BH17 §6.1 First ramification theorem p.942; BH14 §§6.1–6.2 pp.41–42
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

api.statement: L(Θ_π) is the wild orbit of the actual LLC parameter of π.

api.name: endoWildEquiv_tame
api.statement: The sets of tame lifts correspond to restriction of wild orbits from W_F to W_K.

Compare the minimizing tame lifts on both sides.

items.name: Equality of the two conductor profiles
items.statement: For Θ,Υ∈E(F), Φ_Θ(A(Θ,Υ))=Σ_{LΘ}(Δ(LΘ,LΥ)).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Herbrand function of an endo-class
items.statement: Define Ψ_Θ=Φ_Θ^−1∘Σ_{LΘ}, where the inverse is taken on [Φ_Θ(0),∞). The comparison at Θ=Υ gives Σ_{LΘ}(0)=Φ_Θ(0), so the composition is defined on every x≥0.

api.name: endoHerbrand_compare
api.statement: A(Θ,Υ)=Ψ_Θ(Δ(LΘ,LΥ)).

api.name: endoHerbrand_inverse
api.statement: Ψ_Θ is an increasing homeomorphism [0,∞)→[0,∞) with inverse Σ_{LΘ}^−1∘Φ_Θ.

Recover the function by scalar twisting.

items.name: Continuity and finite affine structure of Ψ
items.statement: Ψ_Θ is continuous, strictly increasing, piecewise affine with finitely many derivative breaks, Ψ_Θ(0)=0, and Ψ_Θ(x)=x for x≥m_Θ. Convexity of Ψ is not asserted.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Weil realization of every positive rational slope
items.statement: For coprime a,b>0 there is an irreducible smooth complex Weil representation σ of dimension b and Swan exponent a.
items.locator: BH17 §2.4 Proposition and Corollary, proved §6.3 p.943
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Density of ramification distances
items.statement: For any irreducible σ, {Δ(σ,τ):τ irreducible} is dense in [0,∞).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Conductor characterization of Σ
items.statement: Σ_σ is the unique continuous function f on [0,∞) satisfying f(Δ(σ,τ))=sw(σ∨⊗τ)/(dim σ dim τ) for every irreducible τ.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Higher ramification theorem: open balls
items.statement: For Θ∈E(F), ε>0 and δ=Ψ_Θ(ε), Δ(LΘ,LΥ)<ε iff A(Θ,Υ)<δ for every Υ∈E(F).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Higher ramification theorem: closed balls
items.statement: With the same hypotheses, Δ(LΘ,LΥ)≤ε iff A(Θ,Υ)≤Ψ_Θ(ε).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Tail agreement of Herbrand functions and inverses
items.statement: For x≥A(Θ,Υ), Ψ_Θ^−1(x)=Ψ_Υ^−1(x); equivalently Ψ_Θ(y)=Ψ_Υ(y) for y≥Δ(LΘ,LΥ).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: A truncated endo-class determines a unique ramification pair
items.statement: Given Θ and δ>0, there is a unique pair (ε,ξ), ε>0 and ξ a W_F-orbit in Irr(R_F(ε)), such that tc_δ(Θ_π)=tc_δ(Θ) iff Lπ|R_F(ε) contains ξ. Here ε=Ψ_Θ^−1(δ).
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Every ramification pair determines a truncated endo-class
items.statement: For ε>0 and a W_F-orbit ξ in Irr(R_F(ε)), choose a Weil irreducible containing ξ, let Θ be its endo-class and δ=Ψ_Θ(ε). The equivalence in the preceding item holds, and the resulting truncated endo-class is independent of the choice.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Tame lifting law for every Herbrand function
items.statement: For any Θ, finite tame K/F of index e, and any K/F-lift Θ_K, Ψ_{Θ_K}(x)=e Ψ_Θ(x/e) for x≥0. Unlike the separate Φ and Σ formulas, this does not require Θ totally wild.

items.name: Reduction to a totally wild lift
items.statement: Every endo-class has a totally wild lift over some finite tame extension K/F.
items.locator: BH17 §7.1 Remark p.945; BH14 §6.3 Tame Parameter Theorem
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Totally wild Weil representations
items.statement: An irreducible σ is totally wild precisely when σ|P_F is irreducible. Its dimension is p^r. A singleton orbit of constituents is insufficient without multiplicity one.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

api.statement: The restriction to P_F is an irreducible representation.

api.statement: There is r≥0 with dim σ=p^r.

Study a finite self-twist group of an irreducible P_F-representation.

items.name: Totally wild LLC criterion
items.statement: An irreducible σ=Lπ is totally wild iff gr(π)=deg Θ_π and Θ_π is totally wild.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Reciprocity and Swan exponents of characters
items.statement: Identify smooth complex characters of F× with characters of W_F^ab using a fixed reciprocity normalization. For a ramified character χ, sw(χ)=k iff it is trivial on U_F^{k+1} and nontrivial on U_F^k; tame characters have Swan zero.
items.note: Existing stage scope is an import, not a claim of an available Lean proof.

api.name: localCharacterWeilEquiv
api.statement: Reciprocity induces the normalized character correspondence.

api.statement: For k>0, exact Swan k is nontriviality on U^k and triviality on U^{k+1}.

Measure self-twists by integer Swan exponents.

items.name: Distance under a character twist
items.statement: For totally wild σ and a character χ with sw(χ)=c>0, Δ(σ,χ⊗σ)≤c. If Σ′_σ is continuous at c, equality holds.

items.name: Character action on endo-classes
items.statement: A smooth character χ of F× acts by multiplying a realization θ(h) by χ(det h). In degree one this is multiplication of characters of U_F^1; in higher degree the scalar-translation construction realizes the product. The resulting class χΘ is independent of realization and Θ_{χπ}=χΘ_π.

Remove a scalar leading approximation without changing Ψ.

items.name: Actual level of the translated simple stratum
items.statement: In the setup of §7.4 with deg Θ>1, choose c∈F× linearizing χ on 2v_F(x)>k=sw χ. The translated parameter β+c has the same field and commutator as β. Its level must be m′=−v_a(β+c); if m≠e_a k then m′=max(m,e_a k), whereas equal leading depths can cancel.

items.name: Φ, Σ and Ψ are unchanged by character twisting
items.statement: For every Θ and smooth χ of F×, Φ_{χΘ}=Φ_Θ, Σ_{L(χΘ)}=Σ_{LΘ}, and Ψ_{χΘ}=Ψ_Θ. Total wildness of Θ is preserved.

items.name: Characters of prescribed positive Swan exponent
items.statement: For any local field K and integer k≥1, there is a smooth character of K× of exact Swan k.
items.note: No matching declaration or existing stage at the required scope was found in the bounded audit; route below is a proposal.

items.name: Dense character depths after tame rescaling
items.statement: As K/F ranges over finite tame extensions with e=e(K/F) and χ over smooth K×-characters, the positive values sw(χ)/e are dense in [0,∞). Removing any finite set preserves density.

items.name: Interpolation theorem: sampling formula
items.statement: For totally wild Θ there is a finite D⊂R_{>0} such that for every finite tame K/F with index e, its unique lift Θ_K, and every character χ of K× with sw(χ)/e∉D, A_K(Θ_K,χΘ_K)=e Ψ_Θ(sw(χ)/e). One may take D to contain precisely all derivative breaks of Σ_{LΘ}.

items.name: Character torsor over an irreducible restriction
items.statement: Let ε>0 and let σ_ε be irreducible on R_F(ε), remaining irreducible on R_F^+(ε). Twisting σ_ε gives a bijection from the smooth characters of R_F(ε)/R_F^+(ε) onto irreducible smooth representations of R_F(ε) containing that plus-restriction.

items.name: Commutant dimensions and a ramification break
items.statement: For σ irreducible, let l_ε and m_ε be the number and common multiplicity of its R_F(ε)-constituents, and similarly l_ε^+,m_ε^+. Then d_ε=dim End_{R_F(ε)}σ=l_ε m_ε² and d_ε^+=l_ε^+(m_ε^+)². Σ′ is continuous at ε iff d_ε=d_ε^+.

items.name: Character-twist criterion for a break of Σ
items.statement: For ε>0 and an irreducible constituent σ_ε on R_F(ε), Σ′_σ is continuous at ε iff no nontrivial character χ of R_F(ε)/R_F^+(ε) has χ⊗σ_ε W_F-conjugate to σ_ε. Under this condition σ_ε remains irreducible on the plus group.

items.name: Existing additivity of module length
items.statement: For a ring R and R-linear maps f:N→M, g:M→P, if f is injective, g is surjective and Function.Exact f g, then Module.length R M = Module.length R N + Module.length R P in ℕ∞.

items.name: Existing relative additive index tower law
items.statement: For additive subgroups H≤K≤L of an additive group, H.relIndex K * K.relIndex L = H.relIndex L. In a finite-index situation this is [K:H][L:K]=[L:H].

items.name: Local additive lattice measure and finite index
items.statement: Let F be a nonarchimedean local field with residue cardinal q, V a finite-dimensional F-vector space with its finite-dimensional topology, and μ a nonzero additive Haar measure. For full O_F-lattices N⊆L⊆V, the quotient L/N is finite of finite O_F-length ℓ and μ(L)/μ(N)=[L:N]=q^ℓ. For arbitrary full lattices L,L′ the ratio μ(L)/μ(L′) is an integral power of q.

items.note: Mathematical proof outline only; not a formalized declaration.

items.name: Choice independence of an exact lattice volume ratio
items.statement: Fix an exact F-linear complex 0→U→V→V→U→0 with finite-dimensional U,V, fixed maps, and fixed nonzero additive Haar measures μ_U,μ_V. For any full O_F-lattice subcomplex L=(L0,L1,L2,L3) exact at every position, C(L)=μ_U(L0)μ_V(L2)/(μ_V(L1)μ_U(L3)) is independent of L and of the two Haar normalizations, and is a unique integral power of the residue cardinal q.
items.locator: BH17 §4.1 pp.932–933; independent expansion of the volume argument
items.note: Mathematical proof outline only; not a formalized declaration.

items.name: Scalar dilation of a local-field lattice
items.statement: Let E/F be a finite extension of nonarchimedean local fields with residue degree f and q_E=q_F^f. Let W be an r-dimensional E-vector space and Λ a full O_E-lattice. For β∈E× with v_E(β)=−m, m∈Z, and an additive Haar measure on W, μ(βΛ)/μ(Λ)=q_E^(mr)=q_F^(fmr).

items.name: Upper ramification groups in finite quotients
items.statement: Let x ≥ 0 and E/F finite Galois with Γ = Gal(E/F). (1) The image of R_F(x) in Γ is Γ^x. (2) If x is not a jump for E/F, the image of R_F^+(x) is Γ^x. (3) If x is a jump: (a) if it is the largest jump, the image of R_F^+(x) is trivial; (b) otherwise it is Γ^y for the least jump y > x. In all cases the image of R_F^+(x) is Γ^{x+} = ∪_{y>x} Γ^y.
